title: Aircraft state v1
description: The last known state of one aircraft. Published to Kafka topic adsb.state.v1 with the ICAO 24-bit address as key. States without a position are not published.

callsign.description: Callsign with surrounding spaces removed, or null when unknown.

ts.description: When the position was last updated, UTC, RFC 3339.

lastContact.description: When any message was last received from the aircraft, UTC, RFC 3339.

velocityMs.description: Ground speed in metres per second.

headingDeg.description: True track in degrees clockwise from north.

verticalRateMs.description: Climb (positive) or descent rate in metres per second.

source.description: Where the state came from: a recorded file or the live API.
